name: windsor
description: Connect Windsor.ai to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Windsor.ai MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Windsor.ai to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with marketing data from many sources using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Windsor.ai workspace.
Find anything in Windsor.ai that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review marketing data from many sources in Windsor.ai.
